Printed edition: Autour de la lune seconde partie de De la terre à la lune par Jules Verne, J. Hetzel, 1875, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_bZLTBDa4-cMC. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 79%, 100%, 66% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Jules Verne, Henri Théophile Hildibrand, Émile Antoine Bayard, Alphonse Marie de Neuville, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
